author: Corridor Crew
description:
We often talk about how incredibly complex CG characters and assets fall apart due to the way they're animated. Netflix's Yu Yu Hakusho is an excellent example of the opposite. While their CG work is quite good, it's far from photorealistic. Yet the animation more than makes up for it, really selling the VFX illusion.

Props to Scanline for their excellent work on this series.
title: The POWER of GOOD animation
